{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for missing age (customer_age == -1)
missing_age = data[data['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of missing age entries: {len(missing_age)}")

# Check revenue column type and example
print(f"Revenue dtype: {data['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"First few revenue values: {data['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if the conversion worked
print(f"First few converted revenue values: {data['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Filter the data according to the population
filtered_data = data[
    (data['status'] == 'completed') &
    (data['revenue'] != 999999.99) &
    (data['customer_age'] != -1)
]

# Confirm the filter
print(f"Total rows after filtering: {len(filtered_data)}")

# Check if the data is now clean
print(f"Remaining QA orders: {len(filtered_data[filtered_data['revenue'] == 999999.99])}")
print(f"Remaining refunded orders: {len(filtered_data[filtered_data['status'] == 'refunded'])}")
print(f"Remaining missing age entries: {len(filtered_data[filtered_data['customer_age'] == -1])}")

# Display the first few rows of filtered data
filtered_data.head()"}
